note: Curated starting points for the built-in node-llama-cpp engine. Every entry is a Q4_K_M GGUF from a well-known HuggingFace repo — good quality-to-size ratio for the target hardware. minRamGB is a conservative floor for running the model at a usable speed. Any local .gguf file dropped into the models folder is picked up automatically, so this list is a convenience, not a limit.

models.label: Embeddings (required)
models.description: Turns your documents into searchable vectors. Sidekick's Experts and memory cannot work without an embedding model — this one is small, fast and purpose-built.
models.why: Required. Everything retrieval-related depends on it.

models.label: Balanced (recommended)
models.description: A balanced local assistant for general conversation, research and code.
models.why: Recommended first-run choice. Pair it with the required Nomic embedding model.

models.label: Small & fast
models.description: Quick, light model. Ideal for Sidekick's background work — summaries, fact extraction and research query generation — so your main model stays free for answering.
models.why: Best pick for the Background / Utility model slot.

models.label: Balanced alternative
models.description: A solid general-purpose assistant. Good reasoning at a size most machines can run comfortably.
models.why: The best all-round starting point for conversation.

models.label: Balanced alternative
models.description: Fast and capable, with a different style to Llama. Worth having as a second opinion in a Round Table.
models.why: Different model families disagree in useful ways on a panel.

models.label: Academic & coding
models.description: Strong at structured reasoning, analysis and code — a good voice for research-heavy Experts.
models.why: Pairs well with the academic and legal personas.

models.label: More accurate
models.description: Noticeably stronger reasoning and instruction-following. Slower, but better for analysis, legal and medical work.
models.why: Choose this when accuracy matters more than speed.

models.label: Coding specialist
models.description: A MoE coding model: fast for its quality because only part of its weights activate per token.
models.why: For software Engineering and technical-writing Experts.
